capture_peak_memory.scope: Whole process high-water RSS, not incremental renderer/cache memory.

frame_age_scope: Wall time from beginning of synthetic sample to step return; includes tracking and durable recording. Offline without pacing; not physical capture or delivery age.

numerical_runtime.thread_scope: One worker process; environment requests are not measured effective BLAS thread counts.

scope: Single-process local scripted capture including encoder-only IK; excludes sockets, Godot, real-time pacing, model fitting and hardware. cProfile cumulative scopes overlap.
stage_scope: render_encode includes initial camera; tracking includes control camera updates only. Diagnostic PNG/file-write timers include open/control/finish and overlap parent scopes. File-write timer excludes journal append/fsync; cProfile retains that separate work.
